name: friction AI
description_en:
friction AI measures how AI assistants mention and recommend brands for a configured set of questions. It distinguishes visibility, recommendation, sentiment and competitive position, and supplies answer-level sources plus content suggestions. This is a sampled AI-response monitoring workflow, not a measurement of all real buyer conversations.

The selection question is which models and prompts are actually included in the chosen plan. Although the homepage describes five AI platforms, Starter covers ChatGPT and Gemini; broader coverage, shopping questions and experiments have higher-tier conditions. Its accuracy documentation explicitly separates repeatability from factual validity.
description_zh:
friction AI 衡量 AI 助手针对已配置问题如何提及与推荐品牌，区分可见度、推荐、情绪和竞争位置，并提供答案级来源与内容建议。这是抽样 AI 回答监测流程，不能代表所有真实买家对话。

选型重点是所选套餐实际包含哪些模型和提示词。首页描述五个平台，但 Starter 覆盖 ChatGPT 与 Gemini；更多平台、购物问题和实验有更高套餐条件。准确性文档明确区分可重复性与事实有效性。

core_features.explanation_en: Daily collection examines whether a brand is mentioned, recognized or recommended.
core_features.explanation_zh: 每日采集检查品牌是否被提及、识别或推荐。

core_features.explanation_en: Uses sample volume, collection coverage, variation and stability; original answers can be inspected.
core_features.explanation_zh: 结合样本量、采集覆盖、变化与稳定性，可检查原始答案。

core_features.explanation_en: Professional and above compare control and test prompt sets; not proof of revenue lift.
core_features.explanation_zh: Professional 及以上比较对照与测试提示词集，不构成收入提升实证。

use_cases.basis: Editorial task and fit judgments grounded in the attached primary sources; no observed deployment.

Research scope.en: Public documentation and commercial access reviewed; examples are proposed evaluation workflows.
Research scope.zh: 核对公开文档与商业入口；示例是建议的评估流程。

target_audience.organization_sizes_en: Select by workflow, volume and governance needs; no universal size claim.
target_audience.organization_sizes_zh: 按流程、用量与治理需求选择，不宣称适合所有规模。

steps.en: The homepage says no technical integration is needed: add a brand and configure tracking. Before purchase, reserve enough prompts for brand, category and competitor questions, and check the exact model matrix. This hosted service may fit teams maintaining an ongoing AI-search evidence baseline. It is less directly useful when the task is raw site traffic, conversion attribution or guaranteed rankings. No self-hosted package or open-source license was verified; UI language and regional account availability remain unknown.
steps.zh: 首页说明无需技术集成，可添加品牌并配置跟踪。购买前为品牌、品类和竞品问题预留足够额度，并核对模型矩阵。该托管服务可用于维护持续的 AI 搜索证据基线；若任务是原始网站流量、转化归因或保证排名，则不能直接满足。未核实自托管包或开源许可；界面语言与地区账户可用性仍未知。

items.en: Accuracy documentation builds confidence from enough responses, successful collection coverage, answer consistency and stability over time. A low-confidence score is directional; even a highly repeatable classification can be wrong. Open the underlying answers and inspect sources when available. Missing responses should reduce confidence rather than silently become negative recommendations. The public pages do not establish a collection-retry SLA or prove the reported statistical-significance method for your dataset.
items.zh: 准确性文档从响应数量、成功采集覆盖、答案一致性和时间稳定性建立置信度。低置信度分数只宜作方向参考，高度可重复的分类也可能出错。应打开底层答案并查看可用来源。缺失响应应降低置信度，而不应默认为负面推荐。公开页面未建立采集重试 SLA，也未验证其统计显著性方法对你这套数据的有效性。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: The page lists Starter $69/month for 25 daily prompts and ChatGPT/Gemini, Growth $299 for 50 prompts with Perplexity and Google AI Overviews added, and Professional $699 for 75 prompts including Claude. All three list one brand and one region per brand. Shopping prompts start at Growth; A/B experiments at Professional. Custom handles bespoke limits and regions. Paid plans have a 7-day free trial; no sustained free tier was established. Upgrades apply immediately and downgrades at the next billing cycle.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 页面列出 Starter 每月 69 美元、每日 25 个提示词、ChatGPT／Gemini；Growth 299 美元、50 个提示词，增加 Perplexity 与 Google AI Overviews；Professional 699 美元、75 个提示词并包含 Claude。三档均列一个品牌、每品牌一个地区。购物提示词从 Growth 起，A/B 实验从 Professional 起；Custom 处理自定义额度与地区。付费方案有 7 天免费试用，未确认持续免费档。升级即时生效，降级于下一账单周期生效。

official_check.scope: Public primary-source documentation only. No account execution, purchase, identity claim, price approval, independent review or publication approval.

review_notes: Original English synthesis with section-aligned Chinese translation. Vendor documentation is not an independent performance test.
Hypothetical workflows and suitability judgments are editorial guidance. No directional alternative relationship has been approved.
Evidence text and SHA-256 metadata retained in .scratch/deep-research/batch-12/friction-ai-e2cf6512/; no source text copied into public descriptions.

sections.en: An illustrative SaaS team enters its brand, selects a market and tracks buyer-style comparison questions. Read the original answers behind missing recommendations, identify recurring competitors and cited sources, then assign a content change. Compare the same prompts, models and region after the change. For a Professional experiment, control and test groups of prompts run nightly on a selected engine. Different wording can itself change recommendations; a prompt experiment should not be described as a randomized test of customer purchases.
sections.zh: 例如 SaaS 团队录入品牌、选择市场并跟踪买家式比较问题。查看未被推荐时的原始答案，找出反复出现的竞品和引用来源，再安排内容修改。修改后用相同提示词、模型与地区比较。Professional 的实验会在选定引擎上每晚运行对照和测试提示词集。措辞变化本身就会影响推荐，因此不能把提示词实验描述为客户购买的随机试验。
